findings: Core identity starts from ready_to_show, requires scope nonce, retained Process handle, exact creation nanoseconds, pinned image path/hash, live process, matching fresh discovery PID/data directory. Enumeration checks PID before reading window text.

Exactly one visible same-Core #32770 chooser plus unique production prompt; at warning stage exactly two dialogs, warning GW_OWNER must be original chooser. Direct Edit must be unique, same PID, true parent chooser, visible and enabled. Immediate re-discovery and post-input readback prevent using a stale cached Edit intentionally.

Input uses Unicode SendMessageTimeoutW WM_SETTEXT/WM_GETTEXT below WM_USER, fixed 4096 read capacity, bounded path and truncation checks, flags 0x23 and 1000ms timeout. No remote allocation/injection, custom WM_USER pointer, global keyboard or activation fallback.

Warning verifies exact frozen Chinese text, ResearchOS caption, same PID and chooser owner before dismissing its own IDOK. Invalid nonce sibling remains absent. Same chooser must remain enabled before valid correction; valid fixture ancestry is rechecked for reparses.

BM_CLICK uses pointer-free PostMessageW once per distinct intended stage. Foreground, direct button parent, class, visibility and enabled state are checked again before post. Queue acceptance is not treated as successful confirmation. Unknown outcomes stop further clicks and defer to Root Job recovery.

Revision02 adds pure UTC deadline check after potentially blocking re-discovery and immediately before WM_SETTEXT. PostMessage uses action or cleanup deadline immediately before scalar attempt markers and post. Boundary equality and re-discovery overrun reject; cleanup has its separate deadline. Original retained Core checks remain.

Helper reports only Shell confirmation with Main binding pending. Runner then requires exact React displayed path and real typed Main context/workspace.list with one ACTIVE authorized workspace for same project, followed by same project after workbench opening. Private RealPath and original chooseWorkspace Promise are not falsely claimed observed. Source PIDL/canonical/permission flow is not bypassed.

Runner requires zero task/model/retry budgets, frozen contract and source/bundle/helper pins, fresh exclusive C root, explicit environment, no harness submission/capability branch and no operator fallback. No replay or PID-name kill exists.

Independent hard containment remains external: Root must hold original unnamed kill-on-close Job, assign before resume, preserve full stdout, enforce outer deadline, and establish final exact process exits. Controller validates required scope metadata but correctly does not self-certify Job membership.

Phase, helper journal, bounded raw stdout prefix/digest and authorization uncertainty persist on failures. Normal same-dialog cancel is limited to known pre-valid-confirmation state; app.close is bounded and uncertain cleanup is referred to Root.
